exceptions.quest.fairy_rings: Partial Fairy Tale II access only needs Fairy Tale I chain levels. Full Fairy Tale II completion suppresses this card; 49 Farming and 57 Herblore are not required for rings.
exceptions.quest.world_wakes: 76 Magic OR 76 Ranged, verified against the current ability pages; no fabricated prerequisite quests or combat-level requirement. Death's Swiftness is a self-buff in the current game, not an area restriction.
exceptions.quest.dragon_rider: 60 Prayer is editorial reward relevance, not a quest/equip requirement.
exceptions.non_skill_requirements: Quest points, Kudos, partial stages and combat readiness are not inferred from levels. Cards point toward quests, not assert they can immediately be completed.
